evidence.compact_statement: Source dated not stated reports: FAO says severe droughts have occurred about each decade since the 1960 s; 2020–22 affected western Central Chaco, the Pilcomayo area, Irala Fernández and Mariscal Estigarribia, especially December–February.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated not stated reports: FAO links drought to lower subsistence production for small farmers and Indigenous communities, hydropower generation, waterway transport and drinking-water availability; it identifies Indigenous, rural and agricultural communities as most affected.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated not stated reports: FAO contrasts Central Chaco’s scarce, temporary, salty surface water and non-recharging salty groundwater with generally higher rainfall and more usable, recharging water resources in the east.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.
